observations.observation: The native art remains visibly warmer and more dimensional than the original. Coral rails, cool repeated slats and honey wood supports stay distinct at logical size; no new dead spots, terminal caps, ground shadows or target halos were introduced. Rebuilt supports remain useful design improvements. Exact source registration, functional deck/rail profiles and all4 native rotations/24-frame12fps flowN loop remain intact.

The concrete common-native-world premultiplied composition and area presentation retains the independently verified1344 comparisons. All4 facings,24phases+closure,128/55/32 cell pitches, backgrounds and declared subpixel cases have exact join alpha and at most1/255 join RGB difference. The inspected runs remain continuous through phase and closure. Four sampling helpers and all conveyor pixels are unchanged.

The actual390x844 held-food clock again has a clear dark ring and vertical hand at its existing position, also visible in landscape. At32-cell GPU scale the prior cream dot becomes a readable clock. Across12 clock cases, independently computed dark-ink mass is86.2%–95.6% of direct baseline and hand peak stays at least0.795; the prior version had12.1%–49.8% ink mass. Some softer edge coverage remains, but the symbol is immediately legible at intended size.

The corrected32-cell timer preserves its1.4px nominal minimum and readable progress ring at every declared progress. The128/55 cases keep their relative stroke branch; all56 prior/current timer PNGs there are byte-identical. Ring center/radius and progress/color behavior are retained. Aligned/fractional and portrait/landscape evidence show no material new artifact.

The source diff is exactly the three requested stroke scalings. Five installed production code files match this packet proposal. The new full-renderer probe retains17190 identical picks, hit records/painter order, subpixel screen anchors and exact gallery pixels. Both editor orientations retain clear selection/ghost markers and layout in actual captures. All13 native tests pass in the sealed log.
